title: Line through an opaque sphere
question: Rotate through a full turn. Does the line disappear only where the sphere covers it? Three.js also draws hidden portions as faint dashes.

title: Intersecting translucent planes
question: The order of the orange and blue surfaces should change across their intersection. Standard transparency sorting is intentionally left exposed in both renderers.

title: Opaque pyramid and hidden edges
question: Check whether front faces hide back edges consistently. Three.js uses a separate depth-tested dashed pass for hidden edges.

title: Solid of revolution and a space curve
question: Both sides receive the same 384 quadrilateral surface faces. Compare rotation smoothness and visibility of the curve as it passes around the solid.

title: Math labels and live construction
question: Move a, rotate, resize, and enlarge the page. Both renderers use the same KaTeX labels; geometry sliders must preserve the camera.
